description.value: Kafka's Coffee is a Vancouver specialty roaster and multi-location cafe that has been sourcing beans directly from farmers and roasting them in-house weekly since opening on Main Street in 2010. The Gastown outpost is described as featuring bright colours and huge windows, with an emphasis on high-quality espresso and pour-over coffee. Kafka's doubles as a community arts hub, regularly rotating gallery shows by local painters, photographers, and illustrators.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Kafka's is an active multi-location specialty coffee roaster and cafe; the Gastown location listed on the website as '151 W Hastings St' is the closest match to this OSM record, but OSM lists '155 West Hastings Street' — a clear discrepancy flagged below, with the website value used per rule 12. The Park and Great Northern Way menus show food service and the menu page explicitly labels one item 'Vegan,' confirming plant-based options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website.
